hardware: Apple M5, 16 GiB unified memory, Metal
scope: Callable NDJSON host pipeline: incremental complete-unit prefill on existing owner, independent complete-file callback, versioned receipts before source end, final local callback; replay CLI supports file/stdin read-only previews

method.source: 16 immutable semantic units plus end control, supplied in chunks of at most 7 bytes; fixed gaps 0/20/100 ms
method.end_timing: end delivered immediately after last payload at the same target deadline; no extra end gap
method.baseline: wait for complete source and file callbacks, then one final rendering and budgeted prefill; identical message/event boundaries, model and resource limits
method.model_ready: all source + current file receipts + assistant header evaluated, before final callback
method.first_token_and_output: bounded 16-token preview callback also performs test-only full prompt tokenization; these timings include oracle overhead
method.file_work: trusted fixture C source, deployment-fixed cc unit.c -o unit && ./unit through existing test.run, version-specific isolated directories

native_chat_sanitized_output: PASS borrowed messages: exact upstream message fields, 256 byte/escape corpora, malformed UTF-8 rejection
PASS template: incremental suffix tokens equal independent full tokenization; changed prefix rebuilds; malformed tool rejected
PASS scripted integration: real native prefill -> tool parser -> read -> failing test -> write -> passing test -> read -> DONE
PASS long context: 14357 tokens match full upstream tokenization; cached suffix preserves greedy result

limits: Provider-neutral NDJSON only; no live cloud/SSE/tool-argument string decoder or automatic agentctl integration
Each payload is a separate immutable local user-message unit; not arbitrary BPE-safe append to one message
Comparisons hold event boundaries/final prompts equal; not a benchmark against every conventional agent framework
Source and initial context live in bounded canonical event storage; raw text, model token IDs and KV remain necessary distinct representations
Full Jinja rendering, prefix hash and temporary object copies remain; complete-file concatenation uses measured temporary scratch
Cancellation stops publication at native/callback boundaries, not by forcibly interrupting calls
Old receipts remain queryable with stale flags and are excluded from current-version final prompt
Same evaluated input token count but more decode calls and longer local prefill execution in streaming modes; no energy/FLOP measurement
File processing and some render wall times varied substantially; no lock/CPU profile or reliable p95/p99 estimate from seven samples
Model initialization/initial prefix preparation excluded; input rates are controlled replay, not measured cloud throughput
Replay CLI performs read-only file observation and at most 16 output tokens; does not establish summary/coding capability
No Windows/CUDA or multi-model device-contention acceptance; preallocated KV allocation remains unchanged
